architectural_notes: Cutoff record evaluation rule: include college in results if predicted_rank is less than or equal to closing_rank.

existing_features.title: Adjust the predictions UI to reflect that the results list contains only eligible colleges (predicted_rank <= closing_rank) and ensure the table renders correctly with the filtered results returned by the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: For each cutoff record, include the college in results when predicted_rank <= closing_rank

Update the backend prediction flow so that for each cutoff record, the system includes that record in the returned predictions only when predicted_rank is less than or equal to that record’s closing_rank (i.e., filter out non-eligible records instead of returning all evaluated records).

projectName: Return only eligible colleges when predicted_rank <= closing_rank
